scope: Share identical existing validators and record projections inside their existing schema owner; preserve schema-1 behavior.
changes: Obligations reuse the basis record's optional support/output/test/expectation validators.
Basis input derives its consecutive unchanged fields with pick; retain original order, explanatory comment and tighter input support bound.
Receipt and bounded receipt history share their identical four-state status validator.

capacity.limits: All owner matchers, ceilings, quality ratchets, token/bundle budgets, deadlines and production assertions unchanged. No responsibility moves. The whole 28-responsibility target remains unimplemented/unproven to fit.

characterization.scope: Exact parsed key order and stripping, missing/null optional fields, distinct input/obligation support bounds, common output bounds and independent receipt/history enum vocabulary and diagnostics.
characterization.mutations: An input-only support bound incorrectly reused in a stored obligation and a dispatch-only completed status incorrectly admitted into receipts each fail the intended assertion. Baseline passes. Owned in-memory scratch bundles only, removed afterward.

differential.comparison: Byte-identical generated JSON schemas and serialized acceptance, parsed values including key order, and structured diagnostics against the frozen before implementation.
differential.producerScope: Actual source-kernel Git fixture through open, basis, red, green, synthetic review and no-commit finish; field omissions, nulls, invalid types, unknown fields and array boundaries.
differential.limits: Bounded differential observations, not exhaustive equivalence, historical-record compatibility qualification or independent/native review.

finalSource.method: Sorted unique git ls-files -co --exclude-standard -z -- packages tools plugin; hash path+NUL+bytes+NUL.

builtFeatureJourneys.scope: Actual shipped bundle drives full loan scaffold/finish and brownfield CLI/library repair journeys.
builtFeatureJourneys.limits: Review submissions are synthetic transport; no independent/native review or performance qualification.

retainedSessionReports.scope: Current session files; exact report digests, not public embedded logs.

traceability.updates: Refresh the nine directly changed contract.test.ts working references only; no mapping, semantic acceptance or qualification change.

actionsNotTaken: No schema-2 activation, contract/policy amendment, authentication/exposure change, ASVS waiver, dependency, owner sign-off inference, target/budget amendment, native spike/campaign, commit, push, branch, worktree or release.
